description: This file declares the AckSender class, which implements the IAckSender interface for sending acknowledgments via IPC in the Rialto server component. It includes constructor, destructor, and send method declarations, and references external IPC client classes.

classes.name: AckSender
classes.description: A class responsible for sending acknowledgment messages over IPC in the Rialto server.

methods.name: AckSender
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AckSender with a shared pointer to an IPC client.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Method to send an acknowledgment with a specific ID and success status.
